rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Banned words — grep zero-tolerance.
Ritual / practice (noun) / ceremony — hard ban
No stale markers, no "fixed" retrospectives, no session biography.
Register match.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: AE101 quintet voice holds (Boris-direct Key Concepts, Sutherland-flip Big Idea, Godin-warm prework note); no wrong-register or atmospheric-tone hits in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Rough-cut drafts for articles.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Module file, not an article draft.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Credit original when paraphrasing named technique.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Compound engineering (Klaassen) and Martin's "what would have to be true" are credited below the maintainer cut, which the rule explicitly allows; body carries no unattributed named-technique paraphrase. Creator-name ban, author-we ban, timing placement all clean in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Always "you", never "the student"; teacher framing stays out of body.
Don't smuggle terms of art from maintainer into body.
Over-hedge detector.
Verbatim-frame-cite in reference artefact.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: No reference-artefact frame capture in scope here.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cap practitioner attribution at one student-side mention per module.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Zero body-side practitioner mentions (all attribution lives in maintainer Frameworks block).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Punchy framing keeps punch; carve-out lives downstream.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Key Concepts maxims ("Making it good IS the work", "At least 10% wrong") are terse-register bullets, not overreaching slogans needing a boundary paragraph.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Value-prop / positioning framing belongs in sales copy + project strategy docs, NOT student-facing curriculum body.
Watch out for planting jargon too early.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: "Auto-load", "compound", "keep planning with feedback" all land as callbacks to M1/prework-established vocabulary or verbatim UI labels, not premature terms.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Audit closer when trimming body-prose forcing function.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Section closers checked (Key Concepts final bullet, "## Next" flag-blocks); pronouns/demonstratives resolve to a single clear referent each.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Past tense for exercise recap sections — heading and body.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Module file carries no "What happened" recap section; recap prose lives in the exercise files, not here.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No combative verbs about the agent in body prose.
Headers must be literally true about the mechanism.
Aspirational destination, never corrective gap.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: No tier-pegging phrasing, no ability-level assumption; pre-prompt gates (thinking-effort note, prework criteria) are all plausibly-failable for the audience.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Earn every technical term on first use.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Bare "M2"/"M3" usage is fine at this arc position (module is at M2 or later); Big Idea and Key Concepts define "second-pass read" before using it as shorthand.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Business-audience word ban (Agents 101 default).
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Rule's stated default scope is Agents 101; this file is AE101 (engineer audience, business-jargon ban not the operative register test here).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Memory vs context — use deliberately.
Golden path only in body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 56:"If it did overwrite, the old rules are still in this session's scrollback; ask Claude to restore them."
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: This 'what if the prompt overwrote CLAUDE.local.md' recovery branch belongs below `<!-- maintainer -->` (or a quick reference), not in the student-facing callout — body should stay calm forward-moving narrative.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Trust Claude's defaults for structure.
Q1/Q2/Q3 retro interview is banned at every module.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: "Save the rule if it earned itself" is the opportunistic save-if-earned shape, not a Q1/Q2/Q3 retro repeat.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle another module's voice.
Don't ask student to manually diff or spot-check Claude's output as error-catching.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 56:"Watch the diff: integrating should add the new rule, not overwrite `./CLAUDE.local.md`."
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Manual-diff-as-error-catching is banned by name; recast as "ask Claude to confirm the new rule was added, not the file overwritten" so the agent audits its own edit instead of the student eyeballing the diff.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Simulation personas never alone.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: No self-study simulation persona referenced in this file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No "What research says" callout boxes.
Student moves stay in conversation with agent.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Ctrl+G plan-file editing (a manual practitioner primitive) is only mentioned below the maintainer cut as a Debrief next-tier acknowledgement, not surfaced as the exercise's forcing function in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Specify which CLAUDE.md layer — every time.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Body names the layer explicitly ("personal `./CLAUDE.local.md`") rather than bare "CLAUDE.md".

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No em-dashes. Simple sentences.
Section headers use command verbs when section is about doing something.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Non-canonical headers ("Save the rule if it earned itself") already lead with a doing-verb; canonical section names (Big Idea, Key Concepts, Homework, Next) are exempt.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Inline links use target's title, never filename.
Disambiguate shared-word collisions with Claude Code primitives on first student-authored use.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: "Task-shaping rule" reads as a plain student-authored artifact name, not a collision with a Claude Code primitive literally named "rule" that needs first-use disambiguation.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: LLM-vs-agent-vs-Claude vocabulary discipline.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: "LLM self-charity" correctly names cognitive drift; "Claude wrote a plan you approved" (Start here) is a reflective question about the student's own past product interaction, not an autonomous-work description that should read "the agent".

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No time-of-day anchors in body prose.
Reflection beats stay invisible in flow.
No meta-ask when student has already decided.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Prompt bodies live in the registry, not inlined here; nothing in this file's body re-asks a decision the student already made.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: `.md` is default file type for student artifacts across curriculum.
Cut NVA: true but not moving student forward.
Body "read it" / "look at it" / "notice X" after chat-print = dead weight.
Forward-callout closer: student as grammatical subject.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: "## Next" closers keep "you" as subject of the student's own arc ("you author your first one there", "a real slice with a done you can name"), no role-shift or curriculum-as-subject framing.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Operational reminders live at moment of use, not only where introduced.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Thinking-effort reminder sits at module top (line 3), restating the prework/training-architecture default per convention.
